author: Andrew Fisher
title: GC500 2026 - meet and entry points for all gear and equipment
rule: Andrew, 3 Oct 2026: every delivery or pick-up of gear and equipment goes to the meet/entry point for its area; Coates meets the truck there and places the gear. 'If we unsure they refer back to entry pitlane.' (default below).
method: Each point was marked by Andrew on a Map explorer screenshot. Claude georeferenced each screenshot with an affine fit through the page's own WC pins visible in it (residuals and leave-one-out shift shown). The pit-lane default is the page's own pit-lane entry point.

default.name: Pit lane entry (default when unsure)
default.way_in: Gold Coast Hwy, north-west end of the pit lane, race direction
default.source: page pit-lane point (as used on the 3 Oct toilet sheets)
